faq.q: What is the origin of Saadet?
faq.a: Saadet is associated with Arabic. Saadet is the Turkish form of Arabic سَعَادَة (Saʿāda), meaning 'happiness, felicity'.
Yes — the underlying form سَعَادَت is Arabic.
Saadet can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Saadet should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Saʿāda is not a Quranic personal name.
